title: Ex-EU commissioner Reynders faces new Belgian and Polish scrutiny after EUobserver revelations
lede: EUobserver revealed last week that a director in the Belgian intelligence service (VSSE), had exchanged WhatsApp messages with ex-EU commissioner Didier Reynders, which may have been part of a criminal conspiracy to block VSSE reports into Reynders alleged wrongdoing.
